changelog:
pps-tag v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduces a structured workflow for patent panorama tagging (环节3), focusing on taxonomy design, key technical questions, representative patent packages, demo tagging samples, and candidate export.
- Enforces strict output standards: 4-column technology breakdown, ≥10 key questions (branch-balanced), ≥10 patent packages (each ≥3 families), 20–30 tagging demo records, candidate export for SaaS, and a reader-oriented proposal.
- Does not perform full-sample tagging—outputs are handed off to client SaaS tools for completion.
- Implements automated quality checks for node exclusivity, branch balance, and coverage thresholds.
- Includes optional generation of a panorama statistics HTML report upon user confirmation.
- Requires prior steps and mandatory inputs (candidate pool, SaaS-tagged pool, statistics, value signals) to be completed before use.
summary: 用于专利全景项目的环节3。本 Skill 推荐标引体系，包括 4 列技术拆解表（≤40 个三级节点，彼此互斥）、≥10 个关键技术问题、≥10 个推荐专利包（每包≥3 个同族，六项推荐规则），并提供 20–30 条记录的标引示范和待标引导出文件。全量逐条标引在客户 SaaS 标引工具中完成，不在本 Skill 中完成。
